description: This file contains utility functions for tenant management in a frontend web application. It includes functions to normalize tenant IDs from various structures, manage active tenant state in local storage, fetch session tenants from an API, and select a tenant via backend API call. The file is central to multi-tenant handling in a frontend context, providing helpers and API interactions related to tenant selection and retrieval.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId(t)
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes a tenant ID from various possible tenant-like structures or strings.

methods.name: getActiveTenant()
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant ID from local storage, with backward compatibility for a legacy key.

methods.name: setActiveTenant(tenantId)
methods.description: Sets or removes the active tenant ID in local storage, ensuring the legacy key is cleaned up.

methods.name: clearActiveTenant()
methods.description: Removes the active tenant marker from local storage.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants()
methods.description: Fetches authorized tenants for the current user from the server API.

methods.name: selectTenant(tenantId, reason = 'user-selection')
methods.description: Sets the active tenant by calling the backend API and updates local storage and client-side state accordingly.
